The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.

1. ION Dj2go Controller Mapping with Dextrose Pro Mixer & Red Alert Mobile Mastering Suite

The ION DJ2Go is an entry-level DJ controller designed for bedroom DJs, beginners and mobile DJs that require ultra-portability and all the basic playback controls for DJ software.

Based on a users recent request we’ve just created a new DEX 3 and RED Mobile 3 mapping file for the ION DJ2Go that works for both the Numark DJ2Go and the ION edition.

Disclaimer: This post includes affiliate links

If you click on a link and make a purchase, I may receive a commission at no extra cost to you.

More On The DJ2GO From ION’s Website:

“The ION DJ2GO is not only the most portable DJ controller you’ll find, it’s also incredibly easy to use. This highly capable DJ controller will enpower you with the ability to mix all of your favorite music virtually anywhere.

DJ2GO gives you a tactile feel that can’t be matched by DJing with just your computer mouse and keyboard. In fact, with DJ2GO there’s virtually no need to touch your mouse or keyboard while performing. Everything you need to do, from selecting songs and cueing, to beat-matching and volume adjustment can be controlled by DJ2GO’s generous array of faders, knobs and bright, backlit buttons. DJ2GO weighs just 13 oz. but provides a layout that DJs prefer, including two platters, a crossfader, pitch and level controls as well as Deck A, Deck B, Master and Headphone gain controls. Sync and headphone buttons allow you to instantly sync two tracks and monitor either deck section.

Did we mention DJ2GO is the most portable DJ controller in the world? For the first time ever, you can have a DJ rig right into your laptop case or back-pack—a controller so compact you will barely know it’s there! With DJ2GO you can turn a boring plane ride into an exciting mixing session just as easily as you can turn any get-together into an energized, nonstop party. Plus, DJ2GO is MIDI-compliant, so it can be used easily with virtually any DJ software (Now includes DEX 3 and RED Mobile 3!).

DJ2GO from ION: it doesn’t get any easier to mix, party and perform anywhere.”

For new Digital DJs thinking about making a move from using a keyboard and mouse to having hands-on tactile control with a DJ controller, the ION DJ2Go may be a good first buy.

The ION (or the Numark version) DJ2Go doesn’t include a built-in audio interface (sound card) so for headphone cueing DEX 3 and RED Mobile 3 users will want to invest in a simple 2 channel USB or Firewire Audio Interface. The Numark DJ I/O-2 would be a good fit for this simple bit of kit.

The ION DJ2Go is selling for around $99 on Amazon and some other online retailers, and the Numark DJ2Go version is available at various online DJ equipment retailers.
